warnings: PIPELINE WARNING — task_input_warnings flag 'extraction_record_model_still_hantavirus_named': Verify that the active extraction record schema has been updated from any Hantavirus-named model to a generic or Dengue-specific model before extraction begins. Field mappings (especially for case classification tiers) must reflect Dengue semantics.

PIPELINE WARNING — task_input_warnings flag 'source_discovery_not_yet_disease_generic': Source discovery logic may still be disease-specific rather than generic; confirm that Dengue-relevant Brazilian official sources (MS, SVSA, SES portals) are included in the discovery scope.

EPIDEMIC CONTEXT — Brazil declared a public health emergency for dengue in February 2024; case volumes for Q1 2024 are exceptionally high. Collectors should expect large cumulative figures and frequent situation report updates.
SEROTYPE CONTEXT — Multiple DENV serotypes (especially DENV-3 reemergence alongside DENV-1) were reported in Brazil in early 2024; serotype data is supplementary but may appear in official reports.

LANGUAGE — Primary official sources will be in Brazilian Portuguese. Query terms and extraction logic must accommodate Portuguese-language field labels (e.g., 'casos prováveis', 'óbitos', 'internações', 'semana epidemiológica').

GEOGRAPHIC GRANULARITY — Brazil has 26 states + 1 federal district and 5,570 municipalities. Subnational_location should capture state (UF) at minimum; locality should capture municipality where reported. Do not aggregate state figures into national totals without flagging.
TIME GRANULARITY — Q1 2024 corresponds to Epidemiological Weeks SE01–SE13 (approximately January 1 – March 30, 2024). Map SE numbers to calendar date ranges when populating date_reported.
DATA LAG — SINAN-based official counts may be subject to reporting delays of 1–4 weeks; boletim closing dates should be recorded in evidence_quote or notes.

CASE CLASSIFICATION — Brazilian dengue surveillance classifies cases as: (1) dengue sem sinais de alarme, (2) dengue com sinais de alarme, (3) dengue grave. Map these to cases_confirmed / cases_probable / cases_suspected fields with a classification note.

DO NOT INVENT URLs — This profile provides source planning intelligence only. No URLs have been discovered or validated. Source URLs must be obtained through actual source discovery and collection steps.
